title: Female analysis
summary: Female analysis is a short satirical humor piece written as a mock chemistry reference entry. It presents women as a chemical element, with a symbol, a discoverer, an atomic weight, and sections on occurrence, chemical, mental, and physical properties, uses, tests, cautions, and notes. Each heading is developed as a running joke, so the traditional scientific format becomes a vehicle for gentle ribbing about stereotypes, including supposed spending habits, appearance, driving, and romantic relationships. The piece relies on puns and deadpan technical phrasing, and it closes with a note that most specimens are worth keeping. The author is unknown, and the text appears to be a circulated joke rather than a formally published work, with no plot or characters beyond the imagined 'specimen' of the title.
